BiblicalUsage: Ben-Hanan means "son of favour." He was one of the tribe of Judah. You will find it in 1 Chronicles 4:20.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ben-Hanan is worth remembering, even when little else is told — God counts His people one by one.
